comments.author: Natascha
comments.body: You can get it from Egypt pirates (npc fleet with black sails) that spawn in the bay near Suez. Rare drop so be prepared to spend some time on it.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: This also drops in the hidden passage floors in Giza dungeon. I got this in lower Giza on the hidden passage after floor 10.

comments.author: Tammer
comments.body:
If you want to plunder this the old fashioned way, then you need to be ambushed by a fleet of Egypt Pirates in the Red Sea. They only attack certain level characters; Akasan suggests total level 86-90. My alt was level 88 when I got it.

akasan-uwo.blogspot.com/2011/07/ras-disk.html

There are some visible Egypt pirates in the Red Sea that you can attack, but they do not drop this item.

comments.author: socguy
comments.body: Found this in chest in Luxor lower hidden room (blue orb puzzle variant)
